text:
Maya (Design): quick design ping — uploaded a compact ‘Revision Peek’ prototype for the deployment timeline. goal: let engineers scan version diffs and roll back with minimal context switch. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxx/revision-peek

Noah (Eng): :eyes: curious how this behaves for long commit messages and large diffs — does it truncate or let you expand inline?

Maya (Design): truncates by default, with a ‘show more’ inline expansion. also added a little inline breadcrumb that shows snapshot time + author. trying to avoid a full modal for small rollbacks.

Raj (PM): love keeping it inline. one product ask: can we show whether a revision was part of a canary vs full rollout? that should affect the rollback wording and analytics.

Maya (Design): added a tiny pill: "canary" or "release" next to the version chip. color is desaturated so it doesn't steal focus.

Ellie (A11y): needs an accessible label. screen reader should announce "Revision 42, created by Sam, canary rollout, created May 6th" rather than just reading the pill. also keyboard focus path for expand/collapse.

Maya (Design): good call. added aria text in the spec. sample: ```html
<button aria-expanded="false" aria-label="View revision details for v42: created by Sam, canary rollout, May 6">Show details</button>
```

Noah (Eng): implementation note — careful with the live region when the inline expands. we shouldn't reflow the timeline unexpectedly. maybe animate height with prefers-reduced-motion check: ```css
.revision-peek { transition: max-height 220ms ease; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .revision-peek { transition: none; } }
```

Maya (Design): yep agreed. also thinking about the rollback CTA placement: current mock has inline "Rollback to this" link + compact confirm sheet from the right. alternative is a persistent sticky confirm bar at bottom. thoughts?

Sam (Product Ops): sticky confirm bar could be noisy if people are just browsing history. prefer a slide-over confirm so it's explicit and scoped to the revision. keep rollback destructive language but also immediate undo option.

Raj (PM): also add microcopy that clarifies what gets rolled back. e.g., "This will revert traffic routing and model version to v42. Runtime config changes will not be reverted." short, two-line copy.

Ellie (A11y): for the confirm sheet, ensure focus trap and `role="dialog"` + `aria-modal="true"`. Also provide a clear keyboard shortcut (Esc to close). sample aria pattern included in figma notes.

Noah (Eng): edge case — rolling back to a snapshot created mid-canary. need explicit analytics and a warning: previous canary may have partial traffic data; rolling back could affect metrics. UI should surface that.

Maya (Design): added a warning stanza: "This snapshot contains canary-only traffic. Metrics may be incomplete." with subtle yellow icon. kept it collapsible.

Raj (PM): can we A/B test two things here: A) inline peek + slide-over confirm vs B) inline peek + sticky confirm bar. measure conversion (rollback rate), time-to-rollback, and accidental rollback rate.

Sam (Product Ops): agree on A/B. suggested experiment names: `revpeek_slide_over_v1` and `revpeek_stickybar_v1`. track `rollback_intent`, `rollback_confirmed`, `rollback_undo_within_5m` events.

Noah (Eng): one more engineering nit: the diff render should be lazy-loaded for large revisions. show a spinner placeholder and `aria-busy="true"` while it loads.

Maya (Design): added the spinner state to spec. small copy tweak: change CTA from "Rollback to this" to "Revert to this revision" — feels clearer?

Raj (PM): prefer "Revert to this revision". also change confirm button to "Revert and route traffic" vs secondary "Cancel".

Ellie (A11y): ensure button order follows platform conventions for a11y. also color contrast check on the yellow warning icon background — current mock fails AA at 14px.

Maya (Design): updated colors and bumped icon contrast. pushed a new frame to figma.

design-bot: snapshot created for design file 'revision-peek' by Maya at 1765123700

Noah (Eng): i'll prototype keyboard flow and lazy load behavior this sprint. ping me if you want playbook steps for the regression suite.

Maya (Design): thanks — i'll update the handoff doc with aria snippets and the A/B test names. final microcopy for confirm sheet: "Are you sure you want to revert to this revision? This will switch model version and traffic routing. You can undo within 5 minutes."

Sam (Product Ops): that's clear. +1 for undo window mention.

Raj (PM): moving to review board — schedule 15min to go over edge cases after eng prototype. thanks team. :thumbsup:
